source.label: Event source
source.description: Where events come from. 'Automatic' prefers Noctalia's own calendar service when this build exposes it, and falls back to a vdir.

vdir_path.label: vdir path
vdir_path.description: Directory of .ics collections, as written by vdirsyncer. Point Noctalia's own vdir account at the same path so both read one source.

window_days.label: Window (days)
window_days.description: How many days either side of today to keep loaded. The month grid needs the whole window to draw its dots.

refresh_seconds.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often the background service re-reads the source.

hour_from.label: First hour shown
hour_from.description: Top of the timeline. Earlier events are clipped to this edge.

px_per_minute.label: Timeline zoom
px_per_minute.description: Pixels per minute. A desktop widget cannot scroll, so its height is (last hour − first hour) × 60 × this value: 07–22 at 0.6 is about 540 px. The panel scrolls, so zoom there is free.

max_title.label: Max title length in the bar
